finding.claim: Webhook subscriptions created by any authenticated operator receive lifecycle events (host enrolled/blocked/deleted, cert rotated/expiring) for every tenant's hosts, leaking host names, network IDs, CA IDs, and fingerprints across tenants. Delivery is not filtered by the subscriber's ownership of the event's CA or network.
finding.source: POST /api/v1/webhook-subscriptions (internal/api/server.go:244-245, under bearerAuth at server.go:201); any operator may create (internal/api/webhooks.go:67-93, only allow_private is admin-gated at :73,:127)
finding.sink: Dispatcher.targets -> StoreSource.TargetsFor -> ListActiveWebhookSubscriptions returning all active subscriptions, then POST to each subscriber URL (internal/webhook/webhook.go:226-242, :233; internal/webhook/store_source.go:43-44; internal/store/sqlite_webhooks.go:126-127)

trace.note: route registered for any bearer-authenticated operator
create handler; owner recorded at :89 but never consulted for delivery
emits host.enrolled with host_name, network_id, ca_id
dispatch resolves targets for event type
TargetsFor loads all active subscriptions; filters only by event type (:50)
SELECT ... WHERE active = 1, no owner predicate
deliver POSTs full payload to subscriber URL

finding.guards_checked: Owner recorded at create but not used at delivery (SAFE only for CRUD, webhooks.go:30-35,181-196; not for delivery). allow_private admin gate (not relevant to disclosure). URL validation config.ValidateWebhookURL (not relevant). HMAC signing authenticates payload only, does not scope it. Contrast: web SSE stream /ui/events scopes events by owned network and fails closed (internal/web/events.go:99-156), showing the intended pattern is missing from the webhook path. Other sinks checked and SAFE: SSRF guard in dialer Control hook (webhook.go:325-355; alerts/sinks.go:151-185); rate-limit XFF default off (ratelimit/limiter.go:45,123-131); host/CA/network routes all call ownership helpers; signed poll verifies signature before nonce/timestamp/blocklist; enrollment token checks and revocation gating; disabled-operator sessions rejected (store/sqlite_operators.go:711); OIDC email_verified default-enforced (web/oidc.go:305-318); backup restore exact-name matching with O_EXCL (backup/archive.go:184-230).
